notes.title: New Release Candidate Status
notes.notes:
Long time no talk; sorry about that.

Code
I have gone through all of the code to allow for future updates. Yes, a tiny small step for you; but a huge one for me!

Art
I've worked on some visual improvements,
I've replaced the old NPC, bringing in one of much higher quality, complete with lip-syncing for an even more immersive feel to it! That also makes it easier to add new characters.
I've also updated many of the textures, and now everything looks more compact.

Bgm main menu
Yes, it’s been tough finding just the right song to play as background music for the main menu. However, I think I’ve got it.

Release Candidate 
The game is now in Release Candidate status, so some odd bugs might pop up. I really appreciate your patience and understanding while I'm still fine-tuning everything.
You can find the build in the steam beta section.

Future
This is the last big change in the game and now it goes into production, to add more maps, weapons, enemies, bugs, dialogues and relaxation scenes


Thank you so much for playing

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Life and new enemy
notes.notes:
Life
To prevent a single shot from killing you I added the gameplay of life.
According to the difficulty you will have more or less life, it is divided into blocks and if you rest you go up the block in which you are.
Except if you play on original difficulty, now you can take more than one hit from the Migos.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/2ef1f112c7115652cd1d0c9aa254858dbbe415f3.jpg

Damage indicator
When you receive a damage the screen will turn red to warn you and a red bar will indicate where the damage came from.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/81f325fd0c005a41e739bb2c85641e109467f6a5.jpg


Enemy Drone
Tired of killing migos? A new enemy is presented, shoot at a distance with its four rail weapons, be careful, hide and aim well or it will leave you a strainer.

Update List

Difficulty

 New level of difficulty very easy, instead of a skull there is a tit.
 The enemies need to be closer to kill you in normal and easy.
 Less enemies in easy and normal.

Horde mode

Bugs and confort

 You no longer have to press on the screen to control the camera after using an object or ending a dialogue.
 Less vertical dispersion and better distributed horizontal shots.
 Now we have to move farther away so that the doors are closed with code.
 Irina's tracks are now displayed on the last door.
 It is easier to press the buttons of all interactible objects.



Cosmetic

 The buttons on the doors move when pressed.
 The control panel fuse now has a light pilot, to know that it is pressed.



Gamepad 0.9

 Speed ​​curve for camera movement.
 Adjust the speed of the camera with gamepad in the settings.
 Changed running action to the left stick.
 Dialogs and door controls now work but there is no button legend.
To open eyes A.
To choose a dialog Y.
